name: Seedream 5.5 AI
tagline: Independent web tool for AI image creation and reference-based editing
description: Seedream 5.5 AI is an independently operated creative website for text-to-image generation and image editing with reference pictures. Creators can use the browser interface to develop visual concepts, product images and poster designs, then download their generated results. The pricing page offers one free 1K trial image for a new account, plus paid subscriptions and one-time credit packs. Output settings and reference images affect credit costs. It has no affiliation with ByteDance or BytePlus and receives no sponsorship or endorsement from either. Users must have rights to uploaded pictures and the consent of people shown in them. AI-generated results may contain imperfections and should be reviewed before use.
